fact.title: An appointment letter is mandatory
fact.claim: The Labour Codes make an appointment letter mandatory, in a prescribed format.

script.cover_1: Your first day is Monday. You still have no letter.
script.payoff: Reports say an appointment letter is now mandatory, in a set format.
script.caption: A letter on day one saves a lot of arguments later. Send this to the friend who starts a new job next week.
script.situation: Can a company make you start work with no appointment letter?
script.answer: Reports say the Labour Codes make an appointment letter mandatory, in a set format.
script.reply_me: Could you please send my appointment letter before I start? I would like it for my records.
